items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: The boy we were just talking about, Kid Rene and Louie and Emmon Hart and trumpet players like that. ... All them fellas had a different style. ... That's the style I liked.

ctx.x: Well, how did those corner players you say in later years compare with people like Frank Christian and the real old timers from that era, before your time?

Oh, well, Frank Christian was a... I wouldn't have called him a... He was more of a straight man. Christian. Frank Christian was. He... He wasn't a... Compared to a man like... I'm gonna say, nah, nah, that's my view, viewpoint. I don't know, everybody thinks things different though, but you couldn't compare him with a man like... The boy we were just talking about, Kid Rene and Louie and Emmon Hart and trumpet players like that. You... He was in a different category, I'd say. I'd say, yeah. He was in a...…
Well what about Lester Nelson? We were talking about him a minute ago.
